latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI UGC Video Editor skill.

- Instantly turns raw UGC footage into polished social media clips with simple text instructions.
- Fully cloud-based processing: upload, describe your edits, and download results—no need for manual timeline editing.
- Automatic setup with free token support, session management, and easy connection to the cloud backend.
- Supports multiple user actions like upload, export, check credits, and session state, routed based on your prompts.
- Handles a wide range of formats (video, audio, image) up to 500MB; exports in 1080p MP4 by default.
- Includes clear error handling and guidance for registration, credits, and common workflow tips.
